rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN MR ELASTOGRAPHY / Evaluation of Hepatic Fibrosis (1–3)

criteria.description: Evaluation of hepatic fibrosis in patient with chronic liver disease (e.g. MASLD/MASH, viral hepatitis)
Calculated Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) index score is greater than or equal to 2.67

required_documentation: Laboratory data calculating FIB-4 index score (age, AST, ALT, platelets) or documentation of inconclusive ultrasound elastography
rules.review_notes: Non-invasive quantitative staging of advanced hepatic fibrosis.
